mapper.select: SELECT s.*, d.dname FROM sawon s LEFT JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno WHERE s.sabun = #{sabun};
select * from sawon as s join dept as d on s.deptno = d.deptno where sabun=#{sabun}

WITH RECURSIVE calendar AS ( SELECT GREATEST( DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-01-01')), (SELECT DATE(sahire) FROM sawon WHERE sabun = #{sabun}) -- 입사일과 비교 ) AS day UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(day, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM calendar WHERE day < DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-12-31')) ) SELECT MONTH(c.day) AS month, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) <= '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS lateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true THEN 1 END) AS leaveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.day IS NULL AND sl.use_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS absentCount, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND t.checkout IS NOT NULL THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(t.checkout, t.checkin)) / 3600 END), 0 ), 1 ) AS totalWorkTime FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN ta t ON t.sabun = #{sabun} AND t.day = c.day LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON t.sabun = sl.sabun AND t.day = sl.use_date AND sl.approve = true WHERE DAYOFWEEK(c.day) NOT IN (1, 7) -- 주말 제외 (1=일요일, 7=토요일) AND c.day <= CURDATE() -- 미래 날짜 제외 GROUP BY MONTH(c.day) ORDER BY MONTH(c.day) DESC
mapper.update: update sawon set pwd=#{pwd} where sabun=#{sabun}
